starting_items._comment: if Vocaloid Lock is enabled: a random Vocaloid
if Estate lock is enabled: a random starting estate

if songs are not split-up, one random starting song. If they are split-up, up to six random stages (dependent on other options like vocaloid lock, split-up songs and input lock). Every split-up stage given to the player at the beginning must be completable and related locations in logic. -> starting with Len/KAITO/MEIKO with split-up songs, input lock and one mode only makes the player start with one single stage, which is intentional.
